g.text: 12 original categorical combinations + 14 established continuous-map candidates
Choose for the variable, then inspect the actual figure at its final size.
Equal status: hue separates identities. These swatches do not encode a numeric scale.
Use the colour bar and units. Define zero, endpoints, clipping and missing values.
Give missing data its own key.
The 12 combinations are original design candidates, not colours extracted from the 89 papers.
Some merge in grayscale or CVD simulations. Use labels, markers or panels when identity must survive.
Continuous maps: Matplotlib. CVD diagnostics: Machado 2009 severity 1 in linear RGB; finite scope.
